purpose: 在已签收并完成的 Listing 订单上，验证独立售后权威、部分/多次逆向履约、累计退款与优惠冲回，以及仅在全单退完后关闭订单。

execution_modes.full: create a new forward scenario and execute 19 single-line or 22 multi-line forward writes plus 6 AfterSale writes per case
execution_modes.existing-order: load canonical-aftersales-completed-order-evidence-v1 and execute only 6 AfterSale writes per case

return_plans.full: one case returns the complete remaining quantity
return_plans.partial-then-full: two sequential cases return 1 + 1 units on one line; the first keeps Order COMPLETED and the second terminalizes it
return_plans.multi-line-full: one order has two distinct one-unit SKU lines; returning the first complete line remains PARTIAL and returning the second line terminalizes the order

benefit_modes.none: zero-benefit baseline with 25 one-case, 31 same-line cumulative, or 34 cross-line full-flow client writes
benefit_modes.governed-split: immutable Order application/allocation/funding and exact AfterSale reversal with 25 full-flow writes
benefit_modes.entitlement-backed: eight Promotion lifecycle writes before the forward flow; USED/v4 is retained after a partial reversal and becomes RETURNED/v5 only after full reversal; 33 one-case or 39 partial-then-full writes
benefit_modes.stacked-entitlements: one campaign, two exact templates and two entitlements; both USED/v4 to RETURNED/v5; 39 full-flow writes

forward_flow.multi_line_extension: steps 1-22 create two offers, two one-unit order lines, exact per-line reservations and shipments, and one two-line fulfillment

worker_effect_order: optional cumulative benefit/funding reversal with entitlement retained until fully reversed
Payment refund case delta and accumulate CAPTURED → PARTIALLY_REFUNDED → REFUNDED
Order cumulative settlement records item/order quantities and money
Order CONFIRM_REFUND and RETURN only when cumulative full_return=true

partial_terminal_invariants.resolution_saga: COMPLETED/v8 without benefit or v10 with benefit, plus two per durable retry
partial_terminal_invariants.payment: PARTIALLY_REFUNDED with positive remaining refundable money
partial_terminal_invariants.order_operations: refund and return operation IDs remain null
partial_terminal_invariants.entitlement: RETAINED_PARTIAL until its complete application amount has been reversed

terminal_invariants.resolution_saga: COMPLETED/v12 without benefit or v14 with benefit, plus two per durable retry
terminal_invariants.payment: REFUNDED/v2 for one case or v3 for partial-then-full/multi-line-full
terminal_invariants.inventory: 10/0/10/v4 for one case, v5 for same-line partial-then-full, or one v4 balance per SKU for multi-line-full
terminal_invariants.payable_captured_refunded_minor: 39800 without benefits or 36000 with the governed 3800 benefit
terminal_invariants.after_sale_item_identity: one exact afterSaleItemId linked to the original orderItemId
terminal_invariants.client_commands: 25/31/34 without benefits for full/partial-then-full/multi-line-full; multi-line-full intentionally forbids benefits so it isolates cross-line settlement

safety.ledger: must be atomically created before the first write and checkpointed before/after every request
safety.timeout: query current state by afterSaleId; never retry a write blindly
safety.request_timeout: before afterSaleId exists, query get-by-order-item with exact orderId and orderItemId
safety.manual_review: automatic execution stops; RETRY_RESOLUTION requires human evidence review and explicit authorization
safety.cleanup: refund is irreversible; retain all records and use compensation/manual review, never delete
safety.cdc_timeout: run read-only reconciliation only; never mutate business state to force readiness
